subpages.title: Sobre Nosotros | Laufquen
subpages.desc: Conoce Laufquen, una empresa dedicada a ofrecer soluciones de telecomunicaciones de calidad. Somos expertos en tecnología de redes, fibra óptica y conectividad. Descubre nuestra historia, misión y compromiso con la excelencia para conectar a nuestros clientes con lo mejor en tecnología.
subpages.text: Skip to Content Home Brands Ubiquiti MikroTik GLC Shop Contact us About Us Lista de Precios 0 0 +34 680 587 188 English (US) English (US) Español Sign in Contact Us 0 0 Home Brands Ubiquiti MikroTik GLC Shop Contact us About Us Lista de Precios +34 680 587 188 English (US) English (US) Español Sign in Contact Us About Us Who are we? Laufquen started in Argentina in 1999 as an installer and distributor of telecommunications equipment. Over time, we have grown and become official distributors of renowned global brands, such as Ubiquiti, MikroTik, GLC, Ruijie, Engenius, Vsol, among others. What services do we offer? Distribution in Europe: We offer distribution services to both wholesalers and end consumers, covering the entire European territory. Our extensive range of connectivity and technology products is available to meet the needs of both companies and individuals. Whether you are looking for large-scale solutions for your business or high-quality products for personal use, at Laufquen you will find the connectivity you need in the heart of Europe. Dropshipping : For our partners in Latin America, Laufquen facilitates wholesale trade through an efficient dropshipping service. This versatile model offers wholesalers the opportunity to benefit from direct distribution without the need to depend on our stock. Technical Advice: Our highly trained salespeople not only provide quality products, but also offer specialized technical advice. We are committed to providing our customers with the necessary information to make informed decisions and ensure a successful implementation of technological solutions.
